Roboter-Staubsauger-Rampe

https://makerworld.com/de/models/206743-robot-vacuum-ramp?from=recommend#profileId-821776

Made a stronger vacuum ramp, that does not brake when you step on it.Also now with dovetail joints

 

There are 2 versions now. One with the middel peaces facing the buildplate and one with the bottom. Choose as you wish

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 18mm Bottom Down 0.2mm layer, 3 walls, 5% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 3
- Infill: 5%
- Filament: PLA (#FFFFFF)
